explanation: For large positive float32 exponents, exp saturates to positive infinity and its reciprocal is finite zero. np.where evaluates both branches. The unchanged E decoder clips probabilities to [1e-5,1-1e-5], so overflow-tail saturation gives the same clipped cost as a stable sigmoid.
scope: Full 199 saved native arrays and regenerated teacher graph parity; analytical tail-saturation check. No claim of exact pre-clipping probability equality.
